text:
anya: Heads up — I'm opening a cascade of docs renames to move /docs/reference/* -> /docs/api/* (6 PRs). Need reviewers, redirect rules, and a CI/docs-preview gating plan before any merges.

matt: Can you paste the PR list + preview URLs? Also ping who needs to review each.

anya: Sure — short list: PR #3421 (top-level index rename), #3422 (auth endpoints), #3423 (runtime-config), #3424 (sdk-examples), #3425 (redirects + netlify rules), #3426 (anchor fixes). Previews: https://deploy-preview-3421--docs.redwood.example.com etc.

sam: For merge order: 3421 -> 3425 -> 3422/3423 -> 3424 -> 3426. Reason: index first so redirects can map, then redirect rules, then content, then anchor sweep last to avoid transient broken anchors.

lee: I'll own the redirect patch (PR #3425). I'll add _redirects entries and a small plugin for anchor aliasing. Example rule I'll add:```
# in _redirects
/old-reference/* /api/:splat 301!
```
and a short YAML snippet for our nginx layer:```
- from: "/docs/reference/(.*)"
  to: "/docs/api/$1"
  status: 301
```

matt: Nice. Who's doing the anchor sweep in #3426? We should run linkcheck across all previews before merging anything.

anya: I can run an initial linkcheck and push fixes to 3426, but would like CI to block merges until the global linkcheck passes. Proposal: require docs-preview job to be green + linkcheck:true label.

ci-bot: Build 3421 — docs-preview failed: link-checker reported 18 broken anchors. Full log: https://ci.redwood.example.com/3421/logs/linkcheck

sam: Ok, we'll treat linkcheck failures as blockers. Suggest assigning reviewers: matt for 3421, lee for 3425, sam for 3422/3423, anya for 3424, and matt + anya to sign off 3426 after sweep.

doc-bot: Deploy preview links updated: 3421: https://deploy-preview-3421--docs.redwood.example.com, 3425: https://deploy-preview-3425--docs.redwood.example.com, 3426: https://deploy-preview-3426--docs.redwood.example.com. Diff snapshots available in PR comments.

lee: For coordination, I'll add a short checklist to each PR description: - preview link - linkcheck status - redirect rules included (if applicable) - requests for anchor aliases. That should make it easy for maintainers to gate.

anya: I'll add the checklist and a short migration note for customers (breaking URL change + redirection behavior). Also adding a snippet for SDK consumers in 3424:```
# python snippet to update base URL
from redwood import Client
client = Client(base_url="https://docs.redwood.example.com/api")
```

matt: Timeline? Can we window merges next Tue morning (US) in 1-hour staggered slots so we can monitor search / GA?

sam: Works for me. I'll reserve 09:00-10:00 PT for 3421+3425 merges, 10:00-11:00 for the rest in pairs. We'll roll back quickly if we see errors.

ci-bot: Reminder: protected branch rules require 2 approvals + passing CI + docs-preview success for merges to main.

anya: Great — I'll push final fixes to 3426 today and tag reviewers. Lee please merge 3425 once it has approvals so redirects are live before content moves.

lee: Will do. I'll also run the linkcheck locally with this command:```
npx linkinator "https://deploy-preview-3421--docs.redwood.example.com" --concurrency 5 --reporter summary
```

matt: Awesome. Thanks all — glad we have a clear order and gating. I'll post a short note in #release-war-room when we start merges next Tue. :rocket:

anya: Thanks — tagging @here in PRs once they're ready for review.

(ends)
